items.context: @ZynxBTC (22.433 seguidores), en inglés: Bitcoin podría haber tocado fondo el mismo día con cuatro años de diferencia (21 nov 2022 ~$15,5k y 21 nov 2026 ~$55k); dice que el piso de este ciclo fue 3,5x el anterior y que si se sostiene empieza un nuevo ciclo. Post de ~42 min con 83 likes, 17 respuestas y 2257 vistas. Ángulo: temperatura de mercado y señales de piso (índice de 99,29 a 0,67 en 364 días).
items.suggested_text:
The date match is a fun coincidence, but the higher low is the part with real signal. A cycle bottom roughly 3.5x above the previous one says the floor keeps rising even when sentiment hits zero.

Valuation tells a similar story. My Market Temperature index, which weighs MVRV, price vs the 200-week average, distance from the all-time high and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum at 25% each, went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days. Euphoria to frost in a single year.

A cold reading doesn't confirm the low; it only says how much optimism has already been flushed out. Bottoms usually get recognized long after the fact, once nobody is looking at the calendar anymore.
